notes: auto dumps trigger when mspt stays above blackbox.mspt_threshold_ms for blackbox.sustain_seconds
reason=stall means ticks stopped: a heartbeat thread keeps pushing frozen ring frames so the window survives a freeze
auto dumps are suppressed during startup grace (blackbox.min_server_ticks / blackbox.grace_seconds) and for 60s after the previous one
integrated-server pause (ESC menu) is not a freeze: stats.paused is true and stats.suppressed_by_pause counts the episode
each file = snapshot + ring frames + last 20 errors + last 200 log lines, gzipped
